editorial.name: Tripsy
editorial.descriptionZh: Tripsy 是行程管理 App，把航班、住宿、活动、花销和证件收进同一条 itinerary：转发预订邮件就自动生成行程，航班延误与登机口变更实时推送，还能按角色给同行人分配查看或编辑权限。
editorial.takeawayZh: 一张机票卡加一张花销表讲清一个 App
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，顶上一条深色横幅写 Tripsy 3.9: Smart Routes, Saved Addresses and much more!，导航是 Pricing / Integrations / Blog / Support 与黑色 Get the app 按钮。主标题 All your trip details. Finally, in one place.，下面并排三组荣誉：Editors' Choice（App Store）、App of the Year（2024 Finalist）、15,000+ 4,7 star reviews 与 1.5M+ Downloads。产品图是一台 iPhone：机身上浮着一张 London LHR → Paris CDG 的航班卡（AF1381、5:21 AM、1h 10m、7:31 AM）、一张 Itinerary 卡写 62/51° · Paris, France，右边一张 Expenses 表列 Flight $809.62、Lodging $5,000.00、Shopping $1,652.94、Tour $41.75、Total $7,504.31。往下分 You book it. Tripsy builds it.、All trip activities in one place、Stay ahead of every flight change、Plan Smarter、Sync with Your Calendar、Share Your Trip 几段，其中 Share Your Trip 给了 Collaborator 与 View-only 两档权限说明。
editorial.pricing: Freemium：有 /pro 与 /pricing 两个入口，首页未列价（横幅只宣传 Tripsy 3.9 新版）

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Tripsy 自己的产品截图、获奖背书与权限说明，唯一动作是 Get the app，用户拿走的是这一页的信息密度与排版；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com。
导航只有 Pricing / Integrations / Blog / Support 与 Get the app，没有可下载的设计文件或组件，属产品官网。

pages.title: Tripsy — Travel Planner App, easily organize and find all your trip details.
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

facts.value: All your trip details. Finally, in one place.
facts.evidence: 首屏 h1，副文案写 Flights, stays, activities, expenses, and documents organized. Your all-in-one trip planner app.

facts.value: You book it. Tripsy builds it. — 转发预订邮件即自动生成完整行程
facts.evidence: 正文一段写 Instantly turn your reservation emails into a complete trip. Forward them, and your flights, stays, and activities will appear like magic。

facts.value: 协作成员分 Collaborator 与 View-only 两档，可只放开行程不放开证件与花销
facts.evidence: Share Your Trip 一段的 Set Permissions for Each Guest 说明。

facts.value: Editors' Choice（App Store）、App of the Year 2024 Finalist、15,000+ 4,7 star reviews、1.5M+ Downloads
facts.evidence: 首屏产品图上方的三组获奖与评分标记。

facts.value: 单独为 Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT、Grok 各开了一个集成页
facts.evidence: 站内路径 /integrations/claude、/integrations/cursor、/integrations/codex、/integrations/chatgpt、/integrations/grok-bot，导航另有 Integrations 一栏。
